title: The Batter for the Little Waffles
youtube_title: The Batter for the Little Waffles | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Bibi wants to check on a waffle batter resting in a yellow jug before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Bibi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
